subject.title: feat: add local transcript bridge and coordination handoffs

question: Should ClickClack core accept a loopback-only Claude Code transcript bridge gated by existing human/local-dev auth, an env-configured status script, and a separate capability token?
rationale: The PR intentionally exposes private local transcript content through a new core endpoint, and the accepted auth model determines whether local dev bootstrap is part of the boundary.

options.title: Accept local bridge after cleanup
options.body: A maintainer sponsors the boundary after the contributor removes the release-owned changelog edit or receives explicit release-owner approval.

options.title: Require explicit session only
options.body: Keep the feature but change the endpoint to require a real session cookie or bearer session token instead of local dev fallback before reading transcripts.

options.title: Defer the transcript surface
options.body: Keep or separately review the transport-neutral SDK helpers while removing the private transcript endpoint and /talk reader from this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept local bridge after cleanup
recommendation.body: A maintainer sponsors the boundary after the contributor removes the release-owned changelog edit or receives explicit release-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current hardened rewrite and current-main local-auth helper history points to the same area owner.
